## Context / Problem

The `external LLM (live openai)` arm of the scheduled `Live External Integration` run 42572022074 (2026-11-08 22:16 PST, head `0f409b946e4`) failed 2 of 18 executed tests:

- `tests/external/test_review_discovery_live.py::test_live_plan_review_discovery_reaches_the_provider_and_stays_narrow` (`coverage.llm_ran` is False)
- `tests/external/test_workflow_live.py::test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict` (verdict `INDETERMINATE`)

In both, exactly one `[plan-reviewer] mode=agentic model=openai-responses:gpt-5.4` call was rejected by OpenAI with HTTP 400, `type: invalid_request_error`, `code: invalid_prompt`, message "Invalid prompt: your prompt was flagged as potentially violating our usage policy". In the discovery test the rejected request came right after the finder's 6th tool call (`list_directory`). The plan review then degraded to `INDETERMINATE`, which is rebar's intended fail-closed behaviour for a dead LLM path, so the tests failed as designed.

The previous scheduled run, 41398914029 (2026-11-01, head `c43d9336262`), ran the same arm with the same model and passed all 18 tests. 93 commits landed between the two heads, including plan-review changes (`overlap.py`, `det_closure.py`, `plan_review_fix_unit_grouping.md`, a 2-line wording change in `plan_review_evidence_kind.md`, and new `overlap` input in `workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml`). None of those diffs adds text that obviously resembles policy-violating content, and the `overlap` criterion is off by default.

Public reports describe `invalid_prompt` as a provider-side moderation decision that false-positives on benign prompts with gpt-5.x reasoning models, sometimes triggered by context accumulated across tool calls, and sometimes clearing without any prompt change (openai/codex#43058, openai/codex#46093, usestrix/strix#1162, OpenAI community thread 1339353).

Root cause not established. Unchecked: (1) whether the flag recurs on a rerun at current `main`; (2) which finder/criterion and which message content was flagged; (3) whether an OpenAI-side classifier change between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-09 explains it rather than a rebar prompt change.

Reproduction blocker: the only OpenAI credential available on the operator host belongs to an account with no remaining API credit (every call returns 429 `insufficient_quota`), so the failing tests cannot be rerun locally. Reproduction needs the repository's `OPENAI_API_KEY` (CI only) or a funded local credential.

Found while verifying `unkempt-amaranth-archerfish`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [non-codebase] The flag is either shown not to recur (2 consecutive green openai arms on `main`, run ids recorded as a comment), or the flagged finder and the prompt content that triggers it are identified from a reproduction, recorded as a comment, and fixed by a change that lands through Gerrit.
